title: Van der Holst's classification of the obstructions to Colin de Verdière invariant at most 5
statement:
Let $\mu(G)$ denote the Colin de Verdière invariant of a graph $G$. The $K_7$ and $K_{3,3,1,1}$ families are the graph families generated by the indicated germs under the relevant $\nabla\mathrm{Y}$ operations.

**Van der Holst's classification conjecture.** The graphs in the $K_7$ and $K_{3,3,1,1}$ families are the obstructions to $\mu\leq 5$.

This proposed classification concerns the minor obstructions for the Colin de Verdière invariant bound $\mu\leq 5$. The source presents it as a proposal and does not state that it has been proved or disproved.
source_name: Thomas W Mattman and Andrei Pavelescu, “Three thousand obstructions to knotless embedding”, arXiv:2607.01414 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01414

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2026).
